title: Optimistic status-update mapping in client.gleam is missing the "viewed" arm every other status has
evidence:
let updated_status = case new_status {
                "under_review" -> application.UnderReview
                "shortlisted" -> application.Shortlisted
                "approved" -> application.Approved
                "rejected" -> application.Rejected
                "auto_closed" -> application.AutoClosed
                _ -> app.status
              }
detail: This string->variant map is the parallel of shared.status_from_string / status_decoder / stepper.decode_status / server.parse_status, all of which gained the viewed arm. Here a successful PATCH to "viewed" hits `_ -> app.status`, so the optimistic update keeps the OLD status until the always-fired detail re-fetch corrects it — a transient stale-stepper flash unique to viewed.
recommended_fix: Add `"viewed" -> application.Viewed` to the case (between shortlisted and approved), mirroring the arm added to every other status string->variant map in this PR.

title: slug_for_index doc comment still says range (0..3) after the 4->5 stop expansion
detail: The same diff updated the file header ("four-stop"->"five-stop") and clamp_focus's comment ("four"->"five pipeline stops") but missed this one. The pipeline is now 5 stops (indices 0..4); behaviour is correct (clamp_focus bounds it), only the comment is stale.
recommended_fix: Change `(0..3)` to `(0..4)` in the slug_for_index doc comment to match the five-stop pipeline.
